title: role-spec-template
description: Shape every roles/specs/<name>.spec.json must match (issue #515 realization template, realized batch-1 by issue #521). Hand-checked by gates/role_spec_shape.py — this file documents the shape; it is not itself fed to a jsonschema validator (proposal constraint: no new dependency).

role.description: Role name, matches the sibling roles/<role>.json stem.

source_standard.description: Free text naming the grounding standard(s) this spec's fields/enums are lifted from (e.g. 'EARL 1.0', 'STRIDE / OWASP Threat Dragon').

enum.description: Required and non-empty when type is 'enum'; absent otherwise.

checked_by.description: Path to the enforcing hook/gate file.
Path to the enforcing hook/gate file, or 'TBD (follow-up)' when intentionally deferred.

write_scope.description: Real globs the role may write outside its own record. Empty array is legal only paired with report_only: true.

report_only.description: Required (true) when write_scope is empty; a role that writes nothing but its own record.

board_condition.description: Mechanically evaluable predicate over board/issue state — not a prose sentence requiring LLM interpretation.
